name: @fasttls/fastls
description: Node.js bindings for the Fastls C ABI

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:types && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:types: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --module NodeNext --target ES2022 --types node tests/types.mts tests/types.cts
